E6_applyPersistence_codeInspection.finding: commitHeroVideoIdentity → selectHeroAsset returns null if assetId/mediaUrl/mediaKind missing; acceptHeroFile throws before that if reel lacks id/url. No separate UI branch for saveHeroRecord disk failure beyond catch → preview_pending + Failed status.
E6_applyPersistence_codeInspection.note: Covered live by E4 (missing canonical identity) which exercises throw before partial commit
